almanac.before: Lily Pads let you plant non-aquatic plants on top of them. Special: Short plant. Non-aquatic plants can be planted on it. When specific plants are placed, Lily Pad transforms into a variant of it that can automatically plant the plant that transformed it every 90s. Variants: Sunflower, Wall-nut, Threepeater, Squash, Torchwood, Jalapeno. Special Variants: Doom-shroom: -Cannot be shoveled or moved, immune to damage and does not block zombies. -Cannot be turned into another variant. Kills any plant on itself except Doom-shrooms and Evil plants. -Can start to produce Doom-shrooms 90s after appearance. Every second, all producting Doom Pads have a 0.5% chance to spawn a Doom-shroom. -When a Doom-shroom explosion (except Doom Kelp) triggers on a water tile, a Doom Pad is spawned on that tile. -Can only be removed by turning it into a Cattail using a Fertilizer.

almanac.before:
Princess Solarnova generates sun at extreme speed while melting down nearby projectiles. Can either unleash or store her energy on command.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode | Unlockable</color>
<color=black>Sun Output: </color><color=#8B0000>50/3s</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>•</color> Generates Sun and consumes nearby plant projectiles to absorb energy (1 damage = 1 energy). Energy is capped at Attack damage ×4; excess energy is converted to Sun (1 projectile = 5 Sun).
<color=black>•</color> When energy exceeds Attack damage, fires a solar shot that explodes on impact, dealing 100% Damage in a small area.
<color=black>•</color> Using a Coffee Bean toggles active/inactive modes. Does not attack in inactive mode.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. When a solar shot hits a zombie, it causes nearby projectiles to explode as well, dealing 10% attack damage
2. Energy cap ×3, Sun storage amount ×3</color>

almanac.before:
A scholar who calmly reads the newspaper, but when provoked, he teaches you a lesson with a swarm of cherry-picked students.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>1000</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000 + 15000 (Type 1) + 3000 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to knock-backs.
<color=black>•</color> Invulnerable until his newspaper is destroyed. Upon losing it, he briefly becomes invincible and converts up to 30 zombies (including hypnotized ones) into enraged Gatling Cherry Newspaper Zombie. During this process, he can convert up to 30 zombies that have left the battlefield, and Explosive Cherries that hit plants also trigger a cross-shaped explosion dealing 300 physical damage. He then fires a cherry barrage, catapulting cherries to the last column while accelerating forward. He cannot convert vehicles, flying zombies, aquatic zombies, giant zombies, mini-bosses, bosses or Gatling Doom Newspaper Zombies.
<color=black>•</color> Stops only upon encountering Spikeweed, which instantly destroys his newspaper.
Professor Cherryz has the following 2 skills:</color>
<color=#A86A44>Enlightenment: </color><color=#4B0082>Converts zombies into enraged Gatling Cherry Newspaper Zombies (in Evolved Modes, Gatling Cherry Doctor Zombies).</color>
<color=#A86A44>Backup: </color><color=#4B0082>Carries 1 spare newspaper. When his HP falls below 50%, he takes out the newspaper and resets his state. In Purgatory or Cursed difficulty in Odyssey Survival Mode, he carries 1 additional spare newspaper for each of [Breakthrough] and [Absolute Immunity] modifiers that was not selected.</color>

almanac.before:
Commands the calamitous wrath of the cursed iron cavalry.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>80/0.1s</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color><color=#4B0082>Fast; Extremely Fast during Charge</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>36000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to chill, knock-backs and stuns. Crushes plants. 
<color=black>•</color> Heals for 200 HP every 0.1s.
<color=black>•</color> Without plants blocking his way, he can appear in as far as the fifth column from the right and then charges, riding a warhorse that crushes plants.
<color=black>•</color> When its charge hits a plant, it pauses for ~1.5s, then charges again every 10s.
<color=black>Curse Application</color> Every 0.1s, 1/3 chance to apply [0.1%×(Plant HP + Toughness)] curse stacks to all plants. Bullet hits apply [0.25%×(Plant HP + Toughness)] stacks. Upon collision, applies [5%×(Plant HP + Toughness)] stacks to plants in a 5×5 area.
<color=black>Curse: </color>Damages a plant at full health. When stacks are not zero, increases by 1 stack every 0.1s. If the plant's HP is lower than the stack count, the plant dies immediately. Healing first cancels an equal number of stacks, then restores HP.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifier:</color> When dismounting, transforms the steed into a scythe. Recovers 200 HP for its armor every 0.1s. No longer bites plants, but attacks by swinging the scythe.
Swing: Every 1.35s, causes plants in its current tile and the 5 tiles ahead (can be blocked by Pumpkins) to lose HP equal to its own bite damage, and reduces their Toughness by 50% of the damage dealt, while recovering 10% of the damage as HP for itself. For each plant this effect acts upon, all its damage permanently increases by 10%.
Charge: Every 10 seconds, if in the 4th column or to its right on the map, it can leap to the 2nd column, sequentially releasing 1, 4, and 8 explosions with damages of 1500, 1200, and 1000 respectively (can be blocked by Pumpkins), then vaults to the rightmost column to repeat the aforementioned explosion sequence once.</color>

almanac.before:
<color=#002461>Money</color> is another resource you can use in levels, measured in terms of <color=#008720>coins ($)</color> and capped at <color=#77FFF8>$99999</color>. 
You can spend coins on golden Coffee Beans to upgrade <color=#c9c9c9>silver plants</color> to their <color=#ffe600>gold upgraded variants</color>, or use coins to activate the ultimate abilities of those <color=#ffe600>gold variants</color>.
You start with 3000 coins. Produced money comes in 3 variants, Silver Coin (worth 100 coins), Golden Coin (worth 300 coins) and Diamond (worth 1000 coins).
Tip: Use the <color=#77FFF8>"E" key on your keyboard</color> to quickly pick up and put down the golden Coffee Bean.
You also receive <color=#77FFF8>25 extra sun every 500 coins you spend</color>.
almanac.after:
<color=#002461>Money</color> is another resource you can use in levels, measured in terms of <color=#008720>coins ($)</color> and capped at <color=#77FFF8>$99999</color>.

You start with 3000 coins. Produced money comes in 3 variants, Silver Coin (worth 100 coins), Golden Coin (worth 300 coins) and Diamond (worth 1000 coins).
Tip: Use the <color=#77FFF8>"E" key on your keyboard</color> to quickly pick up and put down the golden Cocoa Bean.
You also receive <color=#77FFF8>25 extra sun every 500 coins you spend</color>.
